verified_source_anchors.description: Canonical Git worktree manager implementing isolated multi-agent environments, ramdisk /dev/shm allocation, zero data cross-talk, non-destructive safety gates, and status reporting.
End-to-end integration and unit tests validating creation, zero cross-talk, dirty worktree protection, and CLI invocations.
Subagent prompt protocol specifying path lanes, base SHA verification, deliverable schemas, and handoff criteria.

interface_assumptions: All concurrent subagents execute in dedicated worktrees created at /dev/shm/clara_worktrees/<PHASE>_<AGENT> or .worktrees/<PHASE>_<AGENT>.
Branch naming follows standard pattern phase/<phase_id>-<agent_id>.
Worktrees are anchored to the ground-truth base commit SHA (879dc5dcfcaae91b3626e28062043d934294478b).
Deliverables must be placed in artifacts/<PHASE>/<AGENT>/ containing change_manifest.json, test_report.md, risk_register.md, and rollback.md.
Teardown of worktrees protects uncommitted changes unless explicit --force is supplied.
